rows.line: Everything on my wall runs 2 batteries to 35 batteries. Fixed, sharpened, loaded, no haggling, mijo.
My shelf runs 3 batteries to 60 batteries, pues. If it stops a pipe, it is on the wall and it is priced plain.
Bueno, one battery, every time, no more no less. Sit down and tell me who you want to be.
Twenty crowns a day of hurt, 2 batteries at his floor. A higher rank man costs more to mend, gracias a Dios he is still breathing.
One skull pays 30, two 60, three 90 batteries, mijo. Fair, and it does not change.
